title: Slugify letters, digits and separators
whatToBuild: A library user calls slugify(text) from src/text.js and gets the title lower-cased, its ASCII letters and digits kept, and every run of any other character turned into one hyphen; an empty string gives an empty string.
testBoundaries: slugify through the exported function in test/text.test.js with node:test, asserting on the returned string only

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every run of characters other than ASCII letters and digits becomes one hyphen
